PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle gain (hypertrophy)"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell bench press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell shoulder press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          cable chest fly 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          triceps rope pushdown 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell back squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg press 3x12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf raise 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          lat pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated cable row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face pull 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds

NUTRITION
  PROTEIN 150g plant
  NOTES
    - Use a variety of plant protein sources: tofu, tempeh, seitan, lentils, chickpeas, beans, edamame, quinoa, buckwheat, amaranth, hemp seeds, chia seeds, pumpkin seeds, soy milk, pea protein powder, vegan protein blends.
    - Aim for 25–35g protein per meal, 4–6 meals/snacks per day.
    - Example day: 
        - Breakfast: tofu scramble with spinach, black beans, wholegrain toast (30g protein)
        - Snack: vegan protein shake (25g protein)
        - Lunch: tempeh stir fry with quinoa and mixed vegetables (35g protein)
        - Snack: hummus with edamame and pumpkin seeds (20g protein)
        - Dinner: lentil curry with brown rice and seitan strips (35g protein)
        - Optional: soy yogurt with chia seeds (10g protein)
    - Supplement with vitamin B12, vitamin D, and omega-3 (algae oil) as needed.
